sources.articleTitle: Hanwha chairman makes 1st visit to Ourhome since acquisition
Hanwha chair puts food safety first on first Ourhome visit

headline: Hanwha Chair Kim Seung-youn Emphasizes Food Safety At Ourhome Site
metaDescription: Hanwha Group Chair Kim Seung-youn urged staff to prioritize food safety during his first visit to the food service firm Ourhome since its acquisition.
aiSummaryBullets: Hanwha Group Chair Kim Seung-youn conducted his inaugural visit to the food service company Ourhome.
The chairman stressed that maintaining food safety standards is more critical than creating unique flavors.
Ourhome became a subsidiary of the Hanwha Group following its acquisition in May 2025.
aiContextParagraph: In May 2025, the Hanwha Group completed the acquisition of Ourhome, a food service subsidiary. Following this transition, Hanwha Group Chair Kim Seung-youn visited the Magok Food Research Center on Wednesday to meet with employees and inspect operations. During the site visit, Kim emphasized the long-term importance of food safety for business stability and consumer trust, noting that once safety standards are compromised, they are challenging to restore. He stated that prioritizing safe food service is paramount, ranking it above the development of new or distinctive menu offerings. This appearance marks the first time the chairman has formally visited the Ourhome facility since the business was integrated into the conglomerate earlier this year. The event highlights the group's ongoing focus on operational standards within its recently expanded portfolio of companies.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent news outlets with steady coverage velocity following the chairman's high-profile business visit.
